stage.quote: Built Coasty to #1 on the OSWorld benchmark (82%) ... Now building CoArena.
stage.note: YC's public page is for 'CoArena' (S26 batch), but its LinkedIn (coastyai), Crunchbase slug (coasty) and founder bios ('Built Coasty ... Now building CoArena') identify it as the same founders/entity behind coasty.ai, confirming the hint's suspicion that CoArena and Coasty are related but distinct products of one company. Team is YC-backed (implies at least a YC pre-seed SAFE); no separately priced seed/Series A round was found in press, so stage is inferred as pre-seed, not confirmed as a named round.

note: coasty.ai (the sandbox/computer-use VM product this card covers) and YC S26 company 'CoArena' (coarena.ai, a crowdsourced computer-use benchmark) share the same two founders (Prateek Jannu, Nitish Kovuru) and the same corporate identity (LinkedIn 'coastyai', Crunchbase org 'coasty', contact founders@coasty.ai) per the YC company page. Founder bios state Coasty was built first ('Built Coasty to #1 on the OSWorld benchmark') and CoArena is a newer, separate product line from the same team, now the one formally in Y Combinator (Summer 2026 batch). No independent funding amount, round, or revenue figures for either product were found in the time available; Crunchbase and LinkedIn pages returned access-blocked (403/authwall) during research.
